description: Mobilitat_Carril Bici is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by 10.1.100.30. Delimitació dels carrils bici de Menorca. Les dades inclouen el traçat i les carecterístiques dels elements que intregen la xarxa ( titular i estat). La capa s'ha generat a partir de la informació proporcionada pels Ajuntaments i el Departament de mobilitat del Consell Insular. Coverage: ES. The listing shows 2 download or service links in SHP, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
